A great dragon rises past the castle's edge on slow wingbeats, briefly dwarfing the towers.
A shaft of divine golden light breaks through the cloud and falls across the floating castle.
A small fleet of airships sails up out of the cloud-sea toward the castle's docks.
A vast storm-front rolls in far below, its dark ceiling brushing the undersides of the isle.
A brilliant comet streaks silently past the castle, trailing a ribbon of pale fire across the sky.
A second sky-island drifts into the first, its cliff-face crumbling in a slow cascade of stone.
A rainbow arcs between two floating isles, its foot dissolving into the cloud-sea below the castle.
An enormous moon climbs behind the castle, flooding the towers in cold silver light.
A flight of white pegasi sweeps around the tallest spire, their wings catching the afternoon sun.
A waterfall pours off the isle's edge and ignites into blazing gold where sunlight strikes the mist.
Lightning laces through the cloud-floor beneath the castle, casting brief violet shadows up the walls.
A second dragon, darker than storm cloud, spirals lazily beneath the isle on enormous black wings.
A war-galley airship lists hard, trailing smoke, and descends past the castle in slow ruin.
A curtain of auroral light rises behind the castle, painting every stone in green and violet.
Dozens of glowing lanterns drift upward out of the cloud-sea, rising slowly past the castle walls.
A meteor shower rakes the upper sky, each streak framing the castle's highest tower briefly in fire.
Three airships engage in battle above the cloud-sea, distant cannon flashes lighting the scene below.
A titan whale breaches from the cloud-sea and arcs silently past the castle's lower ramparts.
A second shaft of light pierces the overcast at a steep angle, crossing the first beam dramatically.
Chunks of a shattered sky-island rain slowly past the castle, trailing long plumes of pale dust.
A cyclone of white birds rises from the courtyard and spirals upward around the main spire.
A river of cloud pours over the isle's rim and cascades down its sides like slow white silk.
A fiery sun touches the horizon directly behind the castle, burning its silhouette into brilliant black.
A vast thunderhead builds in the distance, its crown level with the castle and flickering with light.
A rainbow-winged dragon glides beneath the isle, its reflection shimmering faintly in the cloud below.
